headings_en: Swap the Dumbbell for a Spatula!
dialogue_en: Today, a spatula instead of a dumbbell! Let's make tuna potato pancakes for my muscles!
One hundred fifty grams of potato and eighty grams of drained tuna. One tablespoon each of flour and water.
Thinly shred the potato and gently squeeze out some water. Drain the tuna well too!
Mix in flour and water. It should hold together, rather than drip off the spoon.
Use a lightly oiled pan. Keep them small and thin! Cook both sides over medium-low heat until the potato is cooked through.
Golden outside! Once the potato is soft all the way through, they're ready.
Protein from tuna helps maintain and repair muscles. Your body breaks protein into amino acids and uses them to make muscle proteins.
One plate won't magically grow muscles! Regular exercise and enough food matter too.
A spatula workout while I cook? Oh, you mean I should put the pancake down first?

recipe_ko: 1  감자는 가늘게 썰고 물기를 살짝 짜요.
3  기름 두른 팬에 1cm 이하로 얇게 펴요.
recipe_en: Flour 1 tbsp / water 1 tbsp / oil 2 tsp
1  Shred potato; gently squeeze out water.
2  Mix with tuna, flour and water until thick.
3  Shape small pancakes, no thicker than 1 cm.
4  Fry on medium-low, about 3–4 min per side.
Cook the potato and batter all the way through.
